register_recipe_decorator: register a new ExecuTorch export recipe using the register_recipe decorator under a custom name
discover_recipes: dynamically discover and import all recipe modules in the optimum executorch recipes package
use_recipe_registry: access the recipe_registry dictionary to list all registered ExecuTorch export recipes
create_custom_recipe: create a custom recipe function and register it with the register_recipe decorator for model export
review_recipe_registry: review the recipe_registry module to understand how ExecuTorch recipes are registered and discovered
